name: codie-codex-plugin

scripts.build: esbuild server=src/server.mjs stop-hook=src/stop-hook.mjs agentd=src/agentd.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --legal-comments=none "--banner:js=import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"

description: Codie × Codex plugin; device/pairing/protocol code is shared from ../codie-claude-plugin and bundled into dist/
